depicts: A wide channel banner: a dark band with a red-edged Z emblem on rubble, text beside it, set inside a large flat grey canvas above and below.
text_readable: Readable: "THE OFFICIAL CHANNEL OF", "zExileModz". Faint and hard to read at native size: "DESIGNED BY ATLASHD" at lower left (spelling uncertain).
composition: The artwork is a thin horizontal strip across the vertical middle; flat grey fills the top and bottom of the frame. Emblem sits left of centre, text right of centre.
tone_and_contrast: Very dark black-red strip with dim grey emblem and thin red glowing edges; text is grey on near-black. Low contrast within the strip; the grey surround is slightly lighter than the strip.
sharpness_and_artifacts: Smooth and slightly soft inside the strip with faint particles and vertical banding lines. The grey margins above and below are baked into the image. Small credit text is dim.
scan_first_read: A mostly empty grey rectangle with a dark strip; a red Z shape is barely noticeable.
